title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + RKE2 Debian support + rollback tooling
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Support RKE2-based on-prem/private installs for Debian-family hosts and improve offline bundle vendoring to make air-gapped upgrades reproducible and smaller. This PR adds a new offline bundle pipeline, refactors existing vendoring logic to dedupe common packages, integrates an apt-mirror generator for constrained registries, and provides rollback scripts for kernel/module and package-level changes. Summary of changes: added bundle generation tool (go), apt mirror manifests and helpers, updated helm charts to pin installer image tags, terraform module patches to surface mirror/registry config, deb packaging scripts and tests, and a set of manual QA/upgrade steps. Also includes small UX improvements to installer logs and clearer failure messages when checksum mismatches are detected. Checklist: - [x] Bundle generation tool implemented and unit-tested - [x] Vendoring pipeline updated to dedupe apt/containers layers - [x] Apt-mirror manifest + example infra included - [x] Helm chart values patched for offline registry config - [x] Terraform modules updated (variables + docs) - [x] Rollback scripts & smoke tests added - [x] CI integration for bundle validation - [x] Docs + release notes drafted Commits (high-level): - feat(bundle): new bundle-generator CLI and pipeline hooks - chore(vendor): dedupe vendor tree, compress layers - feat(apt): add apt-mirror manifest templates + generator - fix(installer): improved checksum and retry logic for airgapped pulls - feat(helm): expose offlineRegistry & aptMirror in values.yaml - feat(terraform): add mirror config variables and examples - test: add integration test for bundle validation - docs: add onprem/debian guide and upgrade steps Changed files (high level): - cmd/bundle-generator/main.go - scripts/vendoring/dedupe.sh - tooling/apt-mirror/generator.go - charts/installer/values.yaml - charts/installer/templates/_helpers.tpl - terraform/modules/installer/variables.tf - terraform/examples/offline-with-mirror.tf - scripts/rollback/rollback-packages.sh - tests/integration/bundle-validation.sh - docs/onprem/debian-airgap.md Testing/QA: Unit tests for bundle-generator and apt generator included. Integration job added that runs bundle validation in CI using a small local registry mock. Manual steps used during QA: 1) generate offline bundle on Ubuntu 22.04, 2) bootstrap airgapped cluster (RKE2) using local registry/mirror, 3) perform upgrade + rollback sequence, 4) validate services and KV cache sanity. All QA steps completed twice (fresh install and upgrade path). Backward compatibility: Installer values default to previous behavior if offlineRegistry/aptMirror are not provided. New terraform variables have sensible defaults and are non-breaking. Release notes: Adds Debian/RKE2 support for on-prem airgapped installer, improved offline bundle packing and vendoring to reduce bundle size, adds apt-mirror tooling and explicit rollback scripts for package-level rollbacks. Merge notes: This was reviewed and approved after two iteration cycles addressing packaging edge-cases (missing libseccomp on older kernels) and a flaky integration test. CI initially failed on lint (helm chart formatting) and an intermittent network mock failure; both were fixed and CI green on final run. Merge performed via squash to keep bundle-generator work together.
